verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of a static export, but the changelog mentions a self-hosted container image that serves docs pages (fern-docs-11, fern-docs-31), which gives some host-it-yourself path. The content is also authored as Markdown in your own source repository (fern-docs-22, fern-docs-29), which limits lock-in. This is a server container rather than a portable static bundle, and it appears only in a single changelog line. missing for 10: a documented static-site export/build command, deployability to any static host, docs on how to set up self-hosting and which plans include it, and independent corroboration.
